messages.subject: Blinking of numeric input
parts:
Hi,
Please can somebody help me, I would really appreciate any help.
I prepared the app where I am generating, dynamically, number of numerical and selectinputs(  uiOutput("crops")) based on slider (CombinationSlider), by which I specified number of numeric inputs. see please below how I am generating dynamic amount of numeric inputs.

The issue is that once I am trying to input some numbers, I write e.g. 1 or 2 numbers and after that it starts flashing and blinking, and I can not finish the input.

After some time it stops, but it is really blocking...It does not have any pattern from time to time it just start.

Many thanks for any ideas how to solve it.

Peter




server.r
.....

  output$crops <- renderUI({
    
    NumCrop <<- as.integer(input$CombinationSlider)
    lapply(1:NumCrop, function(i) {
      
      wellPanel(
      
        selectInput(paste0("Oblast",i),label=paste("Select Oblast ",i), 
                        oblastlist<-c(names(OblastList),"pick one"),input[[paste0("Oblast",i)]],width="100%"),
            
            selectInput(paste0("Rajon",i),label=paste("Select Rajon ",i),
                        c(as.character(rajonlist<-sort(unique(ylddata_proxied_final$Rajon[ylddata_proxied_final$Oblast==input[[paste0("Oblast",i)]]]))),"pick one"),input[[paste0("Rajon",i)]],width="100%"),
            selectInput(paste0("Crop",i),label=paste("Select Crop ",i),
                        c(as.character(rajonlist<-sort(unique(ylddata_proxied_final$Crop[ylddata_proxied_final$Oblast==input[[paste0("Oblast",i)]]&ylddata_proxied_final$Rajon==input[[paste0("Rajon",i)]]]))),"pick one"),input[[paste0("Crop",i)]],width="100%"),
            
            numericInput(inputId =paste0( "hectares",i), label = paste0("Hectares Seeded of Crop ",i),min = 0, max = 99999, value = input[[paste0("hectares",i)]],step = 1,width="100%"),
        #numericInput(inputId =paste0( "hectares",i), label = paste0("Hectares Seeded of",i),min = 0, max = 99999, value = input[[paste0("hectares",i)]],step = 1,width="100%"    
        
        hr())
            #             sliderInput(inputId =paste0( "hectares",i), label = paste0("Hectares Seeded of",i),
            #                                                        min = 1, max = 5000, value = input[[paste0("hectares",i)]], step = 1)
            
      
    })
  })

  column(3,wellPanel(
       ....... ,
         hr(),
        uiOutput("crops")

  )
         )
